question.text: Meena holds shares of a large-cap company listed on NSE. Which sub-category of equity does this represent?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook classifies equity sub-categories by industry and by market-cap size, with large, mid and small cap as standard buckets. Shares of a large-cap company therefore sit in the large-cap equity sub-category. The sample question in the workbook lists "Large cap Equity" as a sub-asset class under equity. The Trap: Sectoral and thematic are also valid equity sub-categories, but the stem specifies "large-cap company", so the size-based bucket is the right fit. Small-cap is a different size bucket. Note: Pages 35, 57 and 63 support sub-categorisation of equity by market capitalisation (large / mid / small cap) and by industry / sector.
